narratives.headline: This dashboard presents flexibility data from 15 contributing organisations for the study period Nov 2024-Feb 2025. Total available flexibility capacity is 16,300 MW.
narratives.sector: Sector breakdown data is limited in this release.
narratives.delivery: Delivery factor data is not yet available.
narratives.coverage: Data for this dashboard was provided by 15 organisations. Where fewer than 3 contributors exist for a metric, illustrative values are shown to protect commercial confidentiality.
